name: An accessible repair booking
text: A customer needs the repair timed around a support visit. The replacement part arrives later than the agreed date. The work is usable but one optional adjustment remains.

stages.question: A customer needs the repair timed around a support visit.
answers: Agree the essential repair and access needs
Offer a smaller repair within the original slot
Arrange a partner visit with shared responsibility

stages.question: The replacement part arrives later than the agreed date.
answers: Reschedule openly and verify the part
Fit the confirmed alternative with consent
Use the approved temporary fix

stages.question: The work is usable but one optional adjustment remains.
answers: Record the remaining adjustment and follow-up
Arrange a separate handover review
Hide the unfinished adjustment

name: A community market order
text: A market organiser wants a large order but only a modest budget. Supplier capacity falls before delivery. The organiser disputes one charge on the final invoice.

stages.question: A market organiser wants a large order but only a modest budget.
answers: Agree a realistic quantity and itemised quote
Offer fewer items at the original quality
Share the order with another supplier

stages.question: Supplier capacity falls before delivery.
answers: Prioritise the agreed essential items
Negotiate a smaller documented delivery
Coordinate a supplier handover

stages.question: The organiser disputes one charge on the final invoice.
answers: Explain the quote and offer a documented correction
Renegotiate the disputed part
Erase the disputed charge from the record

name: A repeat-customer handover
text: A long-standing customer wants a new person to handle the service. The successor has questions about earlier decisions. Both contacts want a clear record of who accepted delivery.

stages.question: A long-standing customer wants a new person to handle the service.
answers: Agree the authority and handover record
Limit the service to the original scope
Arrange a joint planning meeting

stages.question: The successor has questions about earlier decisions.
answers: Review the previous records with the successor
Document the limits of the available history
Request an independent check

stages.question: Both contacts want a clear record of who accepted delivery.
answers: Record both contacts and the agreed outcome
Provide a limited handover with open questions
Claim approval that was never given

name: An illustrated anthology
text: Contributors disagree about the scope and credits. One illustration misses the agreed print deadline. The launch audience asks about a missing contributor credit.

stages.question: Contributors disagree about the scope and credits.
answers: Agree each contribution and its credit
Reduce the anthology to confirmed work
Share editing duties with a collaborator

stages.question: One illustration misses the agreed print deadline.
answers: Delay print for the agreed illustration
Release a smaller edition with consent
Arrange a revised contributor schedule

stages.question: The launch audience asks about a missing contributor credit.
answers: Correct the credit and keep the revision record
Explain the omission and publish an update
Claim the uncredited work as my own

name: A small venue performance
text: The venue needs a shorter show than the group rehearsed. A collaborator loses rehearsal time. The sponsor asks for a recording beyond the agreed rights.

stages.question: The venue needs a shorter show than the group rehearsed.
answers: Agree a shorter programme and rights
Use a smaller cast with permission
Share the programme with another act

stages.question: A collaborator loses rehearsal time.
answers: Adapt the rehearsal plan with the group
Perform the prepared sections only
Arrange another supervised rehearsal

stages.question: The sponsor asks for a recording beyond the agreed rights.
answers: Record only what was agreed
Negotiate a later rights agreement
Publish without contributor permission

name: An independent audio release
text: A collaborator wants clear payment and ownership terms. Feedback says the mix obscures a key contribution. The audience expects an honest release note.

stages.question: A collaborator wants clear payment and ownership terms.
answers: Record ownership, scope and payments
Make a smaller release with agreed credits
Share the production work

stages.question: Feedback says the mix obscures a key contribution.
answers: Revise the mix with the collaborator
Release the verified tracks first
Ask another engineer for a review

stages.question: The audience expects an honest release note.
answers: Describe the changes and credit contributors
Delay the release note for a joint review
Erase the contribution from the credits

name: A library evening rota
text: Parents and night-shift workers need different opening hours. Several volunteers cannot cover the proposed evenings. The first month exposed an access gap.

stages.question: Parents and night-shift workers need different opening hours.
answers: Ask users and agree a funded rota
Trial fewer confirmed evenings
Share the rota with another local group

stages.question: Several volunteers cannot cover the proposed evenings.
answers: Confirm replacements and revise opening times
Keep only the covered evenings
Train a smaller volunteer team

stages.question: The first month exposed an access gap.
answers: Publish the access gap and revised plan
Hold a follow-up meeting before expansion
Declare access solved without checking

name: A neighbourhood repair café
text: Residents bring more objects than volunteers can assess. The team cannot source every replacement part. Several visitors mistake an inspection for a completed repair.

stages.question: Residents bring more objects than volunteers can assess.
answers: Define the inspection and repair limits
Offer fewer booked assessments
Share sessions with a qualified group

stages.question: The team cannot source every replacement part.
answers: Prioritise safe agreed repairs
Return the object with a clear report
Arrange a qualified referral

stages.question: Several visitors mistake an inspection for a completed repair.
answers: Explain each actual repair and unresolved fault
Arrange a separate inspection handover
Mark every object repaired

name: A care-network directory
text: Residents want support without exposing private information. Some advertised services cannot accept referrals. The directory needs an accurate update after launch.

stages.question: Residents want support without exposing private information.
answers: Agree consent and verify the listed services
Publish a smaller verified directory
Share verification with the care team

stages.question: Some advertised services cannot accept referrals.
answers: Check availability before making referrals
List only the confirmed services
Arrange a joint service review

stages.question: The directory needs an accurate update after launch.
answers: Publish the verified changes and limitations
Delay expansion pending review
Keep unavailable services listed as active

name: An accessible palace visit
text: Residents want access beyond the ceremonial front entrance. The event team proposes a cheaper inaccessible route. The public asks whether the promised access was delivered.

stages.question: Residents want access beyond the ceremonial front entrance.
answers: Agree resident priorities and a funded route
Offer a smaller accessible visit
Share access planning with local organisers

stages.question: The event team proposes a cheaper inaccessible route.
answers: Verify the accessible route before opening
Reduce the guest list within safe capacity
Arrange a qualified access review

stages.question: The public asks whether the promised access was delivered.
answers: Publish the access results and unfinished work
Hold a follow-up resident review
Claim every visitor could attend

name: A household grant review
text: Local groups disagree over the purpose of a public grant. One funded activity misses its stated deadline. Residents ask for the grant accounts.

stages.question: Local groups disagree over the purpose of a public grant.
answers: Publish criteria and hear the proposals
Fund a smaller verified pilot
Share review with an independent panel

stages.question: One funded activity misses its stated deadline.
answers: Review the missed deadline with evidence
Reduce the grant to delivered work
Arrange a revised funded schedule

stages.question: Residents ask for the grant accounts.
answers: Publish spending and actual results
Request an independent account review
Omit the unfinished funded activity

name: A public flood-support visit
text: Residents ask for practical support while the household wants ceremony. Volunteer capacity is lower than the visit schedule assumes. The public asks what changed after the visit.

stages.question: Residents ask for practical support while the household wants ceremony.
answers: Agree practical tasks with local organisers
Offer a shorter useful visit
Coordinate support through an existing group

stages.question: Volunteer capacity is lower than the visit schedule assumes.
answers: Revise the schedule around confirmed volunteers
Keep only the practical confirmed tasks
Share duties with a trained local team

stages.question: The public asks what changed after the visit.
answers: Report the support delivered and open needs
Arrange a later resident review
Claim the visit solved the recovery needs
